name: cart-dies
description: cart is at the Apartments window 9.5 s early (teleported there at 8 s: this tests Core logic, not pathing) and never fires. Lokier, holding the corridor from Truck, sees him at the recorded spot, 9.4 s before the recorded sighting: G7: outside the encounter window, so the encounter is cancelled and Lokier goes LIVE and fights for real (before G7 his scripted hit was time-shifted to 9.0 s). The round goes on; the puppets nothing reached keep replaying, and the LIVE ones rejoin.
